description: Defines the UberReceivedPacketManager class, which manages multiple packet reception states for QUIC protocol, supporting multiple packet number spaces and related ACK handling.

classes.name: UberReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages multiple received packet managers for different packet number spaces in QUIC, handling ACK frames, packet reception, and related configurations.

methods.name: UberReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing with connection stats.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the manager based on QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if a specific packet is still awaited.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records a successfully received and decrypted packet.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current ACK frame for a packet number space.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Stops waiting for packets before a specified number.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Updates ACK timeout based on recent packet reception.

methods.name: ResetAckStates
methods.description: Resets ACK-related states after ACK is sent.

methods.name: EnableMultiplePacketNumberSpacesSupport
methods.description: Enables support for multiple packet number spaces.

methods.name: IsAckFrameUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the ACK frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest observed packet number.

methods.name: GetAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns ACK timeout for a specific packet number space.

methods.name: GetEarliestAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the earliest ACK timeout among all spaces.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACK frame for a space is empty.

methods.name: peer_least_packet_awaiting_ack
methods.description: Returns the least packet number awaiting acknowledgment.

methods.name: min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Gets the minimum received packets before ACK decimation.

methods.name: set_min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Sets the minimum received packets before ACK decimation.

methods.name: set_max_retransmittable_packets_before_ack
methods.description: Sets max retransmittable packets before ACK (conditional on Cobalt customizations).

methods.name: set_ack_frequency
methods.description: Sets the ACK frequency parameter.

methods.name: supports_multiple_packet_number_spaces
methods.description: Checks if multiple packet number spaces are supported.

methods.name: ack_frame
methods.description: Returns the current ACK frame.

methods.name: GetAckFrame
methods.description: Returns the ACK frame for a specific packet number space.

methods.name: set_max_ack_ranges
methods.description: Sets the maximum ACK ranges.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles an ACK frequency frame.

methods.name: set_save_timestamps
methods.description: Enables or disables timestamp saving.
